subcategory_text: Individuals in specialized roles are provided with awareness and training so that they possess the knowledge and skills to perform relevant tasks with cybersecurity risks in mind
informative_references: ISO/IEC 27001:2022: Clause 7.3, Annex A.5.2, Annex A.6.3
CSF v1.1: PR.AT-2, PR.AT-3, PR.AT-4, PR.AT-5
implementation_examples: Identify the specialized roles within the organization that require additional cybersecurity training, such as physical and cybersecurity personnel, finance personnel, senior leadership, and anyone with access to business-critical data
Provide role-based cybersecurity awareness and training to all those in specialized roles, including contractors, partners, suppliers, and other third parties
Periodically assess or test users on their understanding of cybersecurity practices for their specialized roles
Require annual refreshers to reinforce existing practices and introduce new practices
assessment_objectives: Determine whether individuals in specialized roles are provided with awareness and training so that they possess the knowledge and skills to perform relevant tasks with cybersecurity risks in mind.

Determine whether activities are conducted to identify the specialized roles within the organization that require additional cybersecurity training, such as physical and cybersecurity personnel, finance personnel, senior leadership, and anyone with access to business-critical data.

Determine whether mechanisms ensure that provide role-based cybersecurity awareness and training to all those in specialized roles, including contractors, partners, suppliers, and other third parties.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
